criteria.requirement: Fix actual MarkdownConverter.convert_pre to choose a backtick fence of at least three characters and strictly longer than every consecutive backtick run in the converted code body. Preserve body content, existing strip_pre modes and language callback/fallback behavior. Validate the effective language as a string with no backtick, CR or LF, refusing structural info-line injection. Simple existing pre output must remain unchanged; demonstrate entire embedded fenced samples surviving as one outer code block, not only the presence of a helper.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
